description: Flyme status bar lyrics for YouTube Music. Requires official Third-party lyrics. Includes independent timing control.

patches.name: Flyme status bar lyrics
patches.description: Requires official Third-party lyrics. Adds an independent Flyme status bar lyrics switch (on by default).

release_notes:
YouTube Music 魅族状态栏歌词补丁。请与 Morphe 官方 **Third-party lyrics** 一起修补。状态栏歌词默认开启，默认跟随 MediaSession 时间偏移，取消跟随后可单独调整。

[添加到 Morphe](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=kljjh/flyme-lyrics-patches&name=Flyme%20Lyrics&app=com.google.android.apps.youtube.music&appName=YouTube%20Music)，或下载下方的 `.mpp` 在 Morphe 中本地导入。
repoDescription: Community patch source for Flyme status bar lyrics in YouTube Music, using official Morphe third-party lyrics
